artworks.title: Jean-Antoine de Mesmes
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing the upper body of a man who is positioned facing slightly to his right, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has a long, narrow face with pronounced cheekbones, a small pointed beard, and thin lips. His hair is curly and falls to just above his shoulders, and he wears a small cap on the crown of his head. The man's clothing consists of a fur-trimmed cloak over what appears to be formal attire, including a visible collar. No jewelry or handheld objects are present. The background features an oval frame with dense, linear patterns surrounding the figure, and below the portrait is a decorative coat of arms with ornate designs, including a crescent moon and a star, flanked by roses or lions.

artworks.title: Henri de Mesmes

He is wearing a garment with a high fur collar and a patterned shawl or wrap draped over his shoulder. The background is a detailed pattern of lines and fleur-de-lis designs, framing the oval in which the portrait is enclosed.

artworks.title: Jean de Mesgrigny
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper body visible. He is facing the right, with his left hand resting on a round object. He is not wearing any visible jewelry. The background features an oval frame with a crest at the base, including a lion symbol and ornamental motifs. The text around the oval indicates the man's title as “J.C. Mesgrin President au Mortier au Parlement de Provence.”
